Andante in C and Allegretto in E minor, Hofmeister 1904; Arcadia Trio 4:35 + 4:55. 'Two Terzetti' is not a name in use; the German title is Zwei Terzette
15 trios in 2 books, Simrock 1882; Arcadia Trio (Bella Musica 2008) runs 24:04. Passes the floor only on this one small-label recording

The Grand trio concertant in C minor, Op. 36 on Toccata TOCC 0417 (Trio Klengel) is by August Alexander Klengel (1783-1852), not the cellist Julius; Wikipedia lists it in his discography and IMSLP has it under him. Same work as 104940, with the same key, opus and four movements

The only recording found (Naxos 8.574301, '48 Strings', track 18, 7:02) is of Wilhelm Fitzenhagen's Concert-Walzer for four cellos (Op. 31 per IMSLP and Radio Times; the Apple track says Op. 13). Julius Klengel's published list has no concert waltz; his Hymnus Op. 57 is the only Klengel work on that disc
Bacewicz Quartet, Prelude Classics (2026): three movements, 37:28; quartet dated 1923 (Wikipedia work table and discography)
Bacewicz Quartet: four movements, 39:02; quartet dated 1931 (Wikipedia discography; Nachlass copyright 1931)
Album titles it 'String Quartet No. 4 (1942, unpublished)'; three movements, 25:30
DUX 0974 (2014): four movements, 29:29. Wikipedia's work table gives 1924, out of sequence with Op. 16, so the blank year is left
Faber: Cantata (1977), oboe and string trio, 10 min; Nash Ensemble on NMC 10:25
Faber: 1975, ensemble of 9, 8 min; Wikipedia: flute, cor anglais, clarinet, horn, piano, celesta, string trio, Koussevitzky centennial commission; London Sinfonietta 7:19
Faber: 1970/83, soprano and ensemble of 5, 13 min; Wikipedia: soprano, flute, cor anglais, clarinet, percussion, cello; EMI/Lincoln Center recording (2002) listed in the discography
IMSLP: two movements, 1916-18, UE 1921, first performed 1918; Dante Quartet (Hyperion) 17:28, so 18 stands
Hyperion booklet note: Kodaly wrote the Gavotte for three violins and cello in 1952; Dante Quartet 2:34 (third violin played on viola)

note: Kauder wrote 19 quartets; only Nos. 1-4 are recorded. Kirnberger Trio 4 in D minor (IMSLP 'Trio Sonata in D minor', also on the NeoBarock CD) is not in the catalogue. Fitzenhagen's Concert-Walzer for 4 cellos (IMSLP Op. 31, Naxos 8.574301) may be worth a check. IMSLP also holds Fritz Kauffmann's String Quartet Op. 14 and Abendmusik Op. 51.
